svg.title: Stack
svg.desc: Languages: Python, SQL, C#, JavaScript. ML and AI: LangGraph, LangChain, RAG, scikit-learn, YOLO, U-Net. Agents: NVIDIA Nemotron, Hermes, OpenShell, Harbor, Docker.
